mediaWork.title: The Psychology of Interrogations and Confessions: A Handbook
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: False confessions, police interrogation techniques, psychological vulnerability, miscarriages of justice
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This book examines numerous cases of wrongful convictions resulting from false confessions, exploring the psychological factors contributing to these confessions and the systemic issues involved.  It details various case studies, including those involving police pressure, low intelligence, Munchausen syndrome, and individuals protecting others. The book analyzes interrogation techniques and their impact, proposing improvements to reduce the risk of false confessions and emphasizes the inherent fallibility of judicial systems.
